reviews.author: Dawson Cook
reviews.text: These guys are great! For starters they're open a few hours on Saturdays. I had a tire needing plugged and they had me in and out in 5 minutes. Highly recommend! Thanks guys

reviews.author: John Gutman
reviews.text: Traveling from Indiana, had an engine light come on. They got us in the next morning and fixed the problem in a couple hours. The pricing was also very fair. Would recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Jennifer S
reviews.text: I called and was able to drop my vehicle off for service and diagnostics within a reasonable time frame. Impressed with the turn around time for repairs and the staff’s professionalism. Great local shop! My vehicle drives better than it ever has before.

reviews.author: Noell Mach
reviews.text: My friend and I are in town for a girls weekend. The headlights and taillights on my Ford Escape decided to take a vacation too. These guys got my car in right when I pulled up and started working on it. Unfortunately it was not simply a fuse or a bulb out. It went way deeper than that. They were honest and said it’s not a part they could get and seemed genuinely sorry they couldn’t help me. Finding honest mechanics nowadays is very hard to come by. They did recommend the Ford dealer in town. The Ford dealer service department was not as helpful and only one gentleman there really seemed to want to help us. My drive back to IN should be interesting with only high beams and one taillight. Long story short I’d definitely go to Precision automotive for any car issue as they will be honest and very helpful.

reviews.author: AM A
reviews.text: Trusted them too many times. I first came in to see if they could do oil change, the lady quotes me $70, and to come back Monday. So I did, and it was twice that amount. Whatever, I really needed it, and it is higher end car. Well the guy told me come back two weeks, that he couldn’t reset my oil change, and a light should pop up. The oil light never popped on. Well I came in month and so later because my check engine light popped on. They tried to charge me for the codes of OBD reader when I asked what were the codes. Now I may be a naive woman but I’m not stupid. They proceeded to berate me telling me I should never bought my car and to sell it. They were real rude with me, and as someone who grew up with that place being quick lube first, where people actually trying help you not screw you over, I lost my trust ever going back there. My husband is deployed right now, but if he went in there, there is no doubt in my mind they would have gave him way more respect than they have shown me. They also will lie to you and say no one else will touch your vehicle, just go to the ford dealership instead, more trust worthy than this place. To reply to Mr Andrew, he likes to judge character by old reviews but my last negative review was years ago and I don’t bad mouth I just don’t go out of my way to review unless it’s horrible or fantastic which they left me crying so I’m not going give five stars for horrible behavior/liars. His wife I assume quoted me the $70 when I walked in saying no one else would touch my jaguar, I knew it was odd but she quoted me a good deal that’s why I came that Monday. He never told me the price, I only found out once he printed me receipt and it was twice the amount. They did not charge me but when I asked for the codes they said it would cost me which he clearly forgot that his buddies and his I assume wife said. They proceeded to talk to me as if I was a child. Since he already said what vehicle I had, they acted like I did not know jaguars were expensive. He cleared the codes without telling me, so when I took it to another auto shop they could not check what the so called codes. You say 17, your wife says 15. The shop said none so who knows anymore. Thanks for that. It’s funny how angry your post is saying two sides when you know exactly how y’all treated me.

reviews.author: Matt Waldroup
reviews.text: Great shop! Andrew, Chase, and Mondo all work hard and do excellent work. Finished work on my diesel in a timely matter with a hard task as well. If you need any kind of work on any vehicle highly recommend these guys! Give them a call or go down and see them they are happy to look at any automotive need you may have!

reviews.author: kay pope
reviews.text: Our battery went bad this morning while on vacation in Bryson City. Andrew came out and helped us change our battery no charge! He wouldn’t even accept a tip. Andrew was quick efficient and a very nice young man. I highly recommend Precision Automotive for any automotive help you may need. They are the best!

reviews.author: Sharon
reviews.text: I walked in for a tire rotation only due to the fact that my 5k oil change was done at a quick change place that could not perform this service for some reason . Silly me, I didn't ask the price first. They charged double what I am used to paying. I asked if I had gotten my oil changed would have I gotten a discount?. She said no. She said it took 2 techs to perform. Come on it took 10 minutes and they did get me right in but it cost me $39.68 with tax. I have never paid more than $20-25 at the dealership and at a local tire shop that is an hour drive away. She said you should have had it done there then! That's rude because I told her that's why I needed one without the oil change. Oh, I guess she was nice after all because she told me to have a nice day! Just shop around I'd say, or just pay their price.

reviews.author: Russell Adams
reviews.text: We were in town on a Friday afternoon to ride the SMRR train on Saturday when the right front wheel of my Tacoma locked up 8/10 of a mile from our hotel. Precision Automotive was recommended by another shop bc they were open on Saturday, so I called to let them know I was having my truck towed there. They resolved the issue quickly and got me back on the road the next morning. They saved the day, and the weekend for us.

reviews.author: Bill Honor
reviews.text: My wife and I are on vacation in Bryson City. My Honda Element starts to hesitate on acceleration. The check engine light when on. Yikes! Bad news on the North Carolina hills. We’re in a panic to find a place to get my car repaired. Our search and intuition lead us to Precision Automotive in Bryson City. We were able to get my Element diagnosed with a bad VTEC solenoid. They were able to get part next day and installed in about a hour. Amazing service and professionalism. My car purrs like a kitten again and takes the hills with ease! Precision Automotive makes cars run great again! (A familiar ring to that)

reviews.author: 7.3 GUY
reviews.text: They replaced my complete steering system on my 2000 Ford F350 7.3 pickup including steering box (redhead ) and all linkage and tie rods. Drives like brand new. Also they previously replaced my exhaust system (including down pipe) since this is my forever pickup after recently checking out new trucks just to find they are glorified soccer mom vehicles. THANKS GUYS I'LL BE BACK

reviews.author: Tod Reitmeier
reviews.text: I wouldn’t take my vehicle anywhere else! Iv known Andrew for years, not only is he someone you can trust but he’s brilliant and a wiz of a mechanic. He’s not gonna cheat you he will find the best solution and price you accordingly and most of all FAIRLY. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Tonja Nodine
reviews.text: Top notch shop! We were visiting the area and had one of those car issues. Random, not easy not easy to fix, not sure how we would get our truck fixed. This was the ONLY shop open on Saturday, they took on a job that would make them work longer then normal operational hours. They did NOT over charge us. We paid a fair fee for the repair and they finished an hour earlier then expected. We are very thankful for this business.

reviews.author: Kellye Lomeli
reviews.text: Thank you for doing what the shop down the road couldn't/ wouldn't do. My jeep is my baby and I'm absolutely thrilled that his new BCM is working wonderfully. And the price was amazingly fair. I have other repairs/ projects planned, I will be back.

reviews.author: Holly S
reviews.text: The owner sure made this old lady a happy camper!! The muffler fell off the generator on my camper van. In less than 30 min from the time I pulled in they had me back on the road!! And so reasonable! Wish I could take that place home with me! Thank you thank you!!

reviews.author: Jason Jackson
reviews.text: So five stars to precision automotive they where very helpful and understanding.helped me with the warranty company on sending them all docs and reports etc. get my vehicle fixed after we found out that warranty company wasn't going to pay for it .I asked I I owed them they waved their cost .was very polite and professional.I will be hopefully use them in future and send anyone to them. Thank you Andrew Cable and Christine at precision automotive you made customer out of me I will send any business your way. Jason Jackson

reviews.author: Tim Beavers
reviews.text: This shop is honest and very fast and great prices they have worked on three cars for me and I have been very happy with their work and price. I only wish we had this shop close to Summerville Georgia. Thanks very much for the jobs you have done. Keep up the good work and my God bless you and your family.

reviews.author: Mary Liz Curtner-Smith
reviews.text: We were visiting from out of town and had car trouble. I pulled in, Chase took my brother in law to get his car. I left my car overnight. They replaced the alternator by 10:00 am the next morning. They gave me a very fair price. Thank you!!

reviews.author: colleentrav R
reviews.text: Andrew and his crew are my go to for anything automotive related. jobs that take a typical mechanic shop over a month and a half, two months to complete take Andrew only a few days. I will always take my vehicles and services to precision automotive. Thanks for being awesome to work with and always taking care of my projects!

reviews.author: Cory Coleman
reviews.text: I called on Friday. Andrew told me to come in Monday morning. I brought my truck in Monday morning. I left it with him. It was done in a couple hours. It's hard to find a good mechanic that gets things done on time. Thank you.

reviews.author: Janice Baker
reviews.text: Had a cooling problem with our Nissan Titan . Chase had to run test after test that showed nothing.Good mechanic that he is ,he figured out the problem, replaced the bad parts and got us running again. He even gave us his home phone number in case we had further problems over Easter weekend. Can not say enough great things about this shop.

reviews.author: Danny Wallace
reviews.text: You now have a customer for life!! Andrew Cable fixed our car in one day, and charged us an honest price. Can't get no better than that these days!!

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: Great family owned shop. They really took care of my issue. Had low oil pressure issue going through the mountains. Got a check up and ultimately an oil change to ensure everything was back at 100%. Highly recommend it's hard to find a shop that I trust and this has become the 1!

reviews.author: Dev Sethi
reviews.text: Had what I thought was a mini-crisis with my Hyundai Tucson and an engine malfunction indicator light that popped up the night before. Called Andrew Saturday morning, prompt reply, came midmorning to see him and within 30 minutes he'd run a diagnostic and gave me a full picture of what he found was going on. Great experience and will certainly give him my business again.

reviews.author: Chris Daniels
reviews.text: These guys are great!!! Came to Bryson city for a weekend getaway and blew the CV axle on my truck. Same day service and affordable Repairs!! Keep up the great work guys!!!

reviews.author: Anne Watkins
reviews.text: This place has a new owner, Andrew. He is experienced, very knowledgeable, and conscientious. He is a hard-worker and will do you right. I highly recommend him for all your automotive needs (except tires). Andrew will take care of you.

reviews.author: Tim Hartlage
reviews.text: Cannot thank these guys enough. We were on a five day trip and needed a rear bearing a pads replaced . Without hesitation they got us right in and knocked it out . Thanks for getting us back on the road and saving the rest of our trip . I don’t know what I would had done if you guys didn’t get us taken care of !!

reviews.author: Ryan Frost
reviews.text: They really helped me out when visiting from out of town. Leaking transmission fluid from a previous fill/drain and they were able to get me in and give me peace of mind to make the trip back. Even gave me a ride into town! Great experience

reviews.author: Colleen Reaver
reviews.text: My husband takes all of our vehicles here when we come across any issues they are quick, Knowledgeable and reasonably priced!

reviews.author: Tyler ray Woodard
reviews.text: These people was supposed to fix something on my truck and did a horrible job and also did it completely wrong per the other shop I took it to!

reviews.author: Hunter Ingram
reviews.text: My wife and I were on vacation for singing in the smokies in early July when our truck decided to have a tempature sensor go haywire. We couldn't drive above 20 mph. We thought it was a much bigger issue. Luckily it wasn't, but these guys told us who to call to have it towed to the shop, had it fixed within 30 minutes, and had us on our way. Super great guys and I couldn't recommend them enough!!

reviews.author: Kim
reviews.text: These folks know what there doing,expert mechanics,took care of me late in the day when they didn't have too.Treated me with utmost respect and pricing was very fair.

reviews.author: David Steltenpohl
reviews.text: While on vacation in North Carolina, our vehicle started having transmission trouble. Justin at Advance Auto recommended that we take it to Precision automotive to have it checked out. Andrew stayed past closing time to diagnose the problem, which meant a great deal to us during a stressful situation. Their customer service is outstanding, and they are honest, knowledgeable, and genuinely care about helping their customers. We are very grateful for Andrew's dedication and highly recommend them to anyone needing reliable automotive service.

reviews.author: Michael Purcell
reviews.text: We came to Cherokee to celebrate our anniversary, and, unfortunately, our Jeep decided it no longer wanted to go into gear. To make matters worse, it happened on a Friday afternoon, so I was scrambling to find an automotive shop that would even be open on Saturday. Thankfully, I found Precision Automotive. I had my Jeep towed there around 2:30 a.m. and left a voicemail explaining the situation. From the moment they received my message, they were incredibly helpful and professional. They worked us into their schedule, quickly diagnosed the problem, and got us back on the road. The customer service was outstanding, and they truly went above and beyond during what could have been a very stressful situation. I can’t thank them enough for their honesty, professionalism, and willingness to help. A++++ service! I highly recommend Precision Automotive to anyone looking for a trustworthy and dependable repair shop.

reviews.author: Matt Phillips
reviews.text: Not kidding, a blessing in humanity after being turned down for a simple tire repair from other shops. These guys were nice, fast and did a great job when I just showed up without an appointment on a Saturday. Wish they were in my hometown, they’d get all my business. Highly recommended! Good people! Good techs! Ive been in the car business for well over 30+ years and I can honestly say if you have an issue with this shop it’s not them it’s definitely you, they are good. Couldn’t be happier. Thank you all for taking care of me!!! Seriously, Highest of recommendations, I’ll be back and recommend to my family in Bryson City -Matt
